title: B2B Data Infrastructure & Enrichment Specialist
description: We are looking for a B2B Data Infrastructure & Enrichment Specialist to design, build, and maintain a scalable system for continuous B2B data acquisition and management. This is not a one-off list building role. You will be responsible for creating and managing an end-to-end data supply chain that fuels our outbound marketing, sales outreach, and growth initiatives. You will play a key role in ensuring our teams always have access to accurate, enriched, and highly targeted prospect data aligned with our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP). What You’ll Be Responsible For - Data Infrastructure & Systems - Design and implement scalable infrastructure for ongoing B2B data collection - Build systems that allow us to turn data collection and enrichment workflows on/off as required - Develop repeatable processes for sourcing, storing, and updating prospect data - Identify and integrate data tools, APIs, and automation platforms where needed - Data Sourcing & List Development - Source broad, high-volume prospect datasets aligned with defined ICPs - Build initial data pools across target industries and decision-maker roles - Continuously expand and improve data coverage across new markets and sectors Enrich datasets with key attributes such as: - Contact information - Company firmographics - Technographic data - Intent and behavioural signals Segment data to support multi-channel outreach strategies including email, paid media, and sales engagement Maintain high data accuracy and deliverability standards Data Quality & Optimisation - Monitor data performance and accuracy - Identify and remove low-quality or duplicate records - Continuously refine targeting criteria to improve outreach results - Work closely with marketing and sales teams to optimise data performance Essential Skills & Experience - Experience sourcing and building B2B prospect databases - Strong understanding of ICP development and targeting strategy - Experience with data enrichment platforms and contact verification tools - Knowledge of CRM and sales engagement platforms - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - Ability to design scalable and repeatable data processes Highly Desirable - Experience building automated data workflows - Familiarity with scraping tools, APIs, or automation platforms - Understanding of outbound sales and marketing data requirements - Experience working with multi-channel outreach datasets What Success Looks Like in This Role - A scalable, controllable data acquisition infrastructure - Consistent supply of high-quality, enriched B2B prospect data - Improved targeting accuracy and outreach performance - Reliable data pipelines that support growth across multiple campaigns Respond with "Convrsion" at the top of your proposal so we know you read this thouroughly.
